FINAL CHECKS · ITEM 03 / 05

Total, average or marginal總、平均或邊際

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Distinguish total, average and marginal values; use the marginal value for an additional-unit decision.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

總值是累積金額，平均值為總值除數量，邊際值是多一單位的變化。問是否增加一件，就使用額外收益及額外成本。

A total is an accumulated amount; an average divides a total by quantity; a marginal value measures the change from an additional unit. Match the measure to the question's decision.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：TC(4)=40 and TC(5)=47. At q=5, ATC=9.4 but fifth-unit MC=7. 平均與新增成本不同。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

TC rises from 100 to 118 when Q rises from 10 to 12. MC per extra unit over this interval? 每額外單位成本？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
